title: Baatu Devoted yi ci wetu yonent bi
intro: Ci réew mu sori, kilifay nguur ci jamono jooju dañu ko bañ bu baax. Waaye ay ruuh yu ndaw yu gëm Yàlla taxawoon nañu ci wetu jaamu Yàlla boobu, yàkkamtee tontu wooteb Yàlla. Seen gëm-gëm bu dëggu bi dina xaajale réew mu am doole mi, ba noppi mujjee am ndam ci kaw dooley gëm-gëm gi.
clues: Nun mbooloo mu ndaw lanu woon, bokk ngëm ak mébet.
Nu taxaw ci wetu ab ndaw bu mag bu kilifay seen réew bañoon.
Ba Yonent bii laajee: “Kan ñooy samay jàppale ci yoonu Yàlla?” nu tontu ci lu amul benn xalaat.
Nu laaj ndaw si mu wut noos ci asamaan si ngir féexal sunu xol.
Ci nit ñi ci jamono jooju, amna ñu gëm ci sunu bataaxal, ñeneen ñi dëgër bopp bañ, waaye Yàlla dafa dooleel gëmkat yi.
Nun la Hawwariyyun — di taalibe yu gëm Isa, ñu am ndam ci ndimbalu Yàlla.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
